environment.description: Same Laravel 10 application deployed on AWS ECS Fargate (2 replicas) in private subnets (10.0.128.0/20, 10.0.144.0/20) with no NAT gateway egress path for inbound initiation. Service is exposed exclusively through a VPC Endpoint Service (AWS PrivateLink) with com.amazonaws.vpce.us-east-1.vpce-svc-0a1b2c3d4e5f67890 service name. The VPC endpoint policy restricts access to a single consumer VPC (vpc-0xdeadbeef) owned by the internal mobile backend service account (arn:aws:iam::111122223333:root). The endpoint's security group (sg-0abc123def456) allows TCP/443 only from 10.1.0.0/16 (consumer VPC CIDR). There is no internet gateway, no public IP assignment, and no ALB — traffic arrives only via the PrivateLink ENI. The consumer service is a single-threaded queue processor that serializes all wallet operation requests through an SQS FIFO queue (MessageGroupId = wallet_id) before forwarding to the endpoint, meaning concurrent requests for the same wallet are physically impossible at the network layer.

config.infrastructure: AWS ECS Fargate, 2 replicas, private subnets only
config.network_exposure: AWS PrivateLink (VPC Endpoint Service) only, no IGW, no NAT for inbound
config.consumer_architecture: SQS FIFO queue with MessageGroupId=wallet_id, single-threaded consumer
config.public_access: None - no ALB, no API Gateway, no CloudFront distribution
config.dns: No public DNS record, only vpce-*.us-east-1.vpce.amazonaws.com private DNS
